description: This line plot illustrates the Accuracy@1 (%) for two models, GPT-4o and Claude-Sonnet, as a function of the number of child nodes in a tree structure, referred to as "Tree Width". The x-axis, labeled "Number of Child Nodes (Tree Width)", is linearly scaled and ranges from 1.5 to 5, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)", is also linearly scaled and ranges from 20 to 35, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The GPT-4o model is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at an accuracy of 24.4% at a tree width of 1.5, rising to 28.9% at a width of 3, peaking at 34.4% at a width of 4, and then declining slightly to 31.1% at a width of 5. The Claude-Sonnet model is represented by a dashed light blue line with star-shaped markers, starting at 26.7% at a width of 1.5, rising to 27.8% at a width of 3, then declining to 24.4% at a width of 4, and further declining to 20.0% at a width of 5.
